hook.name: UnipixelHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 afterSwap hook for the Unipixel collaborative pixel canvas. On $uPIXEL token sells, it reads the seller address from hookData and calls the canvas contract to reconcile the seller's pixel allocation to their new token balance. Reconciliation is best-effort via try/catch; swaps always proceed regardless of canvas state.
